_comment: Tier-2: DamApplication thermal laws have a Python CLASS name that differs from the string under which they are registered for Materials.json. Pitfall (kratos.dam #0). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv). hasattr(DAM, 'ThermalLinearElastic2DPlaneStrain') is True while HasConstitutiveLaw of that same string is False; the registered strings are ThermalLinearPlaneStrain / ThermalLinearPlaneStress / ThermalElasticIsotropic3D, none of which is a Python attribute. Pick the route first, then the name. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics for real; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
